title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.27
subtitle: Two solver engines and a compact account card.

highlights.title: AETHER and GAIA engines
highlights.description: Choose AETHER, the official unmodified PPF Contact Solver, or GAIA, the PolyWorks build. Existing installations keep working and stay selected.

highlights.title: Install GAIA in Preferences
highlights.description: Connect a PolyWorks account with GAIA access, then install, update or repair GAIA with a verified, resumable download. Classic needs no account.

highlights.title: One Account & License card
highlights.description: Superhive and the optional PolyWorks services now share one compact, read-only card. GAIA can run reproducible Bakes on request.
